description: How each logical type in data-model/model.json is declared per database.

id.postgres: BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

string.note: SQLite does not enforce the length; the API validates it.

decimal.note: SQLite stores NUMERIC with REAL affinity; values are rounded to 2 places by the API.

timestamp.note: SQLite returns naive datetimes; the backend treats them as UTC (utils/time.as_utc).
